sessions.final_text:
The fix is in and I've recorded my claims; the spec and repro criteria still need the independent verifier.

I rewrote `parseValue` in `parser.go`. A value that starts with a double quote is now scanned up to its closing unescaped quote, so a `#` inside the quotes stays in the value. After the closing quote, only a `# ...` comment or nothing is allowed; any other trailing text now returns an error. Unquoted values still end at the first `#`. I added `TestQuotedHash` in `parser_test.go`, covering all four README cases.

interlock's runs of `checks/quoted-hash.sh` (it prints `Issue #42: retry`) and `go test ./...` both passed on the final tree. I recorded claims for repro (observed), regression (tested) and spec (tested). I did not commit.

- **repro**: pass (observed). interlock ran `checks/quoted-hash.sh` on tree e4b35cd and it printed `Issue #42: retry`.
- **spec**: pass (tested). `TestQuotedHash` passes for all four rules. A manual `kvconf get` run also confirmed `\"` with a `#` inside quotes, a comment after the closing quote, and a trailing backslash.
- **regression**: pass (tested). interlock ran `go test ./...` on the tree and both packages passed.

checks_run: interlock check run --criterion repro; interlock check run --criterion regression; git rev-parse HEAD; git status --short; cat parser.go; grep -n "TestQuotedHash" -A60 parser_test.go

go test -run 'TestQuotedHash|TestParseErrors' -v . 2>&1 | tail -8; cd /tmp && printf '[a]
q = "say \"hi\" #x" # c
b = "C:\\" # c
' > /tmp/t.conf; cd - >/dev/null; go run ./cmd/kvconf get /tmp/t.conf a.q; go run ./cmd/kvconf get /tmp/t.conf a.b

interlock assess add --criterion repro --strength observed --ref "interlock check run --criterion repro" --note "check passed on tree e4b35cd, output 'Issue #42: retry'"
interlock assess add --criterion spec --strength tested --ref "go test -run TestQuotedHash -v; plus kvconf get on escaped-quote/backslash/comment file" --note "TestQuotedHash covers #-in-quotes, unquoted #, comment after quote, \\\\ escape; manual run confirmed \\\" escape with # and comment, and trailing backslash"
interlock assess add --criterion regression --strength tested --ref "interlock check run --criterion regression" --note "go test ./... passed on tree e4b35cd"
interlock check run --criterion repro; interlock check run --criterion regression

interlock claim add --criterion repro --strength observed --tree auto --ref "interlock check run --criterion repro" --note "check passes, prints Issue #42: retry"
interlock claim add --criterion regression --strength tested --tree auto --ref "interlock check run --criterion regression" --note "go test ./... passes"
interlock claim add --criterion spec --strength tested --tree auto --ref "go test ./... (TestQuotedHash, TestValues)" --note "tests cover quoted #, unquoted #, comment after quote, \\\" and \\\\ escapes"
